prompt: istio TracingServiceName APP_LABEL_AND_NAMESPACE missing app label fallback
answer: For `TracingServiceName: APP_LABEL_AND_NAMESPACE`, if the workload has no `app` label, Istio uses **`istio-proxy`** as the fallback. The service name is constructed from that fallback and the workload namespace, e.g. `istio-proxy.<namespace>`. ([Istio docs](https://istio.io/latest/docs/reference/config/istio.mesh.v1alpha1/))
